csw:Record.dct:abstract: NSW Office of Environment and Heritage Macarthur Forest Fire Danger index. Modelled fire frequency projections at ~10km resolution for 2060-2079 period using CSIRO-MK3.0 and R3 ensemble member using the WRF 3.3 model. This product will provide policy makers, land managers and researchers access to accurate and temporally fine scaled information with which to make hazard reduction and management strategies.
